description: A typing speed test that shows both your raw and your real WPM. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

elapsedMs.description: Time taken, in milliseconds. Words per minute counts five characters as a word; 0 scores 0 wpm rather than dividing by zero.

includeCharacters.description: Also return a verdict for every character of target: correct, incorrect or pending. Off by default because it is thousands of strings for a minute of typing.

target.description: The passage the person was supposed to type. Compared against typed character by character, position by position.

typed.description: What was actually typed, exactly as entered. Shorter than target is fine; the untyped rest counts as pending.

name: typing_test
title: Typing Test
